# Proximal operators

The soft-thresholding operator is the proximal operator of the L1 norm.

```{r}
library(ProximalOpt)
soft_threshold(c(-3, -1, 0, 2), lambda = 1)
```

# LASSO on the synthetic Douala housing dataset

The included housing observations are simulated for teaching purposes only.

```{r}
housing <- load_housing_data()
X <- model.matrix(
  ~ superficie_m2 + nombre_chambres + age_logement_ans +
    distance_centre_km + zone,
  data = housing
)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
y <- housing$prix_millions_fcfa

set.seed(2026)
train <- sample(seq_len(nrow(housing)), 400)
fit <- fista(X[train, , drop = FALSE], y[train], lambda = 1.2)
head(predict(fit, X[-train, , drop = FALSE]))
```
